id: AT-SW-05 (settings writer: set and reset land in the case's temp HOME)
note: HOME-GUARD (0.1.2): `settings set --apply` and `settings reset --apply` write ${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/settings.json; under this runner that is the case's temp $HOME/.claude/settings.json, with no CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The real settings files (the real HOME's and the account's ~/.claude/settings.json, and the CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR one the runner started with) keep their sha256, or stay absent, across both writes, and the runner's own temp HOME gets no .claude

steps.name: set: the write lands in the temp HOME
the real settings after the set
reset: the member goes from the temp HOME's file
the real settings after the reset
